resolved_findings.issue: Mandatory beta CLI incompatibility originally functionalFAIL66
resolved_findings.resolution: Approved source-side proxy compatibility omits extensions; gateway still denies all four; released native fake and real canaries pass.

resolved_findings.issue: Inherited $150 provider budget overrode the $2 guarded budget
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit per-agent credit_max_cost_usd is applied after provider budget mapping. Missing or invalid budgets fail before token acquisition or transport. Deployed overlay specifies $2.

resolved_findings.issue: Host/provider/socket/config environment selectors could route around gateway
resolved_findings.resolution: Namespace allowlist then forced route/model controls; installed fake smoke and actual live jobs pass; managed disk policy remains authoritative and incompatible image must fail canary.

resolved_findings.issue: Initial live unknown usage retained 1,320,000 microUSD and froze admission
resolved_findings.resolution: Cumulative usage replacement and null preservation were repaired with strict numeric, TTL and category validation. The entire original hold was permanently debited without invented usage. External exposure was booked before retries; four later receipts settled automatically.

resolved_findings.issue: Last raw diagnostic delta could conceal previously merged totals
resolved_findings.resolution: LastVerified captures merged typed totals after every successful merge; last_delta remains separate. Multi-delta null preservation regression passes.
Bounded typed billing receipts are emitted only after successful durable settlement. Parse, pricing, stream and storage failures emit no success receipt.

resolved_findings.issue: Agents-only raw upload could erase guarded overlay/canary
resolved_findings.resolution: Presence of either credit configuration variable synchronously delegates to the canonical Terraform pipeline. Child failure causes no raw upload or outer roll. The legacy absent-key path is preserved; hash and stat failures fail closed.

resolved_findings.issue: Disabled evaluator review proposal required actual rollout proof
resolved_findings.resolution: Reviewed one GCS object update with no resource additions, deletions or IAM changes. All three environment builds succeeded. Live dev/prod YAML, effective CLI config and ready coordinators match the overlay; test remains unchanged. Production bytes match the plan exactly and all 45 non-target agents, including the manual canary, are identical.

financial_invariant_review.renewal: Only explicit fresh-credit confirmation renews capacity. Key rotation, date changes, reconfirmation, deployment and promotion do not replenish it.
financial_invariant_review.original_unknown_metadata_preserved: Actual remains 0 and UpstreamID empty; immutable original request transitions its full 1,320,000 microUSD hold into a conservative debit.
financial_invariant_review.hard_bound: Each admitted send reserves the verified full-window, worst cache-TTL and output bound of $1.32 before durable forwarding. Atomic account, task, day and canary checks precede sends; ambiguous sends retain full exposure. Immutable pricing and strict request admission reject unsupported billable features.
financial_invariant_review.budget_scope: Anthropic API allocation only; Cloud Run, Firestore, logging and compute charges are separate. Existing deployment administrators intentionally retain credential administration under the attended decision; this is outside the runtime-job guard.

live_canary_evidence.receipt_rounding: Per-request upward rounding explains CLI $0.00650803 versus ledger $0.006509 for dev and CLI $0.00651528 versus ledger $0.006516 for prod.
